notes: Exact Focal Kanta N°1 Product Data Sheet (2024, v4). It specifies a passive two-way bass-reflex bookshelf loudspeaker with one 6.5-inch Flax bass/midrange driver and one 27 mm IAL3 pure-Beryllium tweeter. Published response is 46 Hz–40 kHz (±3 dB), low-frequency point 42 Hz (-6 dB), sensitivity 88 dB (2.83 V/1 m), nominal impedance 8 ohms and minimum impedance 3.9 ohms. The sensitivity reference and nominal impedance are retained exactly for impedance-dependent conversion. The 25–150 W figure is recommended amplifier power, not speaker power handling, so power remains N/A. No response points are digitized. Source: https://media.focal-naim.com/dam/kanta-n-1/fp_kantan-1_en.pdf.
